items.title: The Secret to Marathon-Winning Humanoid Robots
items.titleCn: The Secret to Marathon-Winning Humanoid Robots
items.summary: On 19 April 2026, the Honor Lightning humanoid robot ran a half-marathon in 50 minutes and 26 seconds, beating the human world record by 7 minutes and the best robot time from 2025 by almost 2 hours.H...
